WITH source_events AS (
  SELECT ts, CAST("body" AS VARCHAR) AS raw_text, lower(coalesce(severity, '')) AS level, to_json(struct_pack(ts := "ts", id := "id", service := "service", severity := "severity", body := "body", trace_id := "trace_id", span_id := "span_id", source := "source", attributes := "attributes", resource := "resource")) AS sample
  FROM {{logs}}
  WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end
), normalized AS (
  SELECT ts, trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(raw_text, $cf1, $cf0, 'g'), $cf2, $cf0, 'g'), $cf3, $cf0, 'g'), $cf4, $cf0, 'g'), $cf5, $cf0, 'g'), $cf6, $cf0, 'g'), $cf7, $cf8, 'g')) AS pattern, level, sample
  FROM source_events WHERE raw_text IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(raw_text)) > 0
), bucketed AS (
  SELECT *, least(29, greatest(0, CAST(floor(epoch(ts - $start) / nullif(epoch($end - $start), 0) * 30) AS INTEGER))) AS bucket
  FROM normalized
), totals AS (
  SELECT pattern, level, count(*) AS count, arg_max(sample, ts) AS sample
  FROM bucketed GROUP BY pattern, level
), top_patterns AS (
  SELECT *, count(*) OVER () AS total_patterns FROM totals
  ORDER BY count DESC, pattern, level LIMIT 200
), bins AS (
  SELECT b.pattern, b.level, b.bucket, count(*) AS count
  FROM bucketed b INNER JOIN top_patterns p ON b.pattern = p.pattern AND b.level = p.level
  GROUP BY b.pattern, b.level, b.bucket
), trends AS (
  SELECT pattern, level, to_json(list(struct_pack(bucket := bucket, count := count) ORDER BY bucket)) AS trend
  FROM bins GROUP BY pattern, level
)
SELECT p.pattern, p.level, p.count, p.sample, p.total_patterns, t.trend
FROM top_patterns p INNER JOIN trends t ON p.pattern = t.pattern AND p.level = t.level
ORDER BY p.count DESC, p.pattern, p.level
